designer_intent.goal: Create a minimal but aggressive West Coast hip-hop arrangement focused on a hook-driven energy flow using sample-based textures and one-shot sample hits named after slicing techniques.

presetor_intent.presetor_goal: Preserve minimalism while highlighting the hook sections with distinct sample-based layers and texture beds.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythm tracks with sliced one-shot drum samples emphasizing aggression and groove suitable for West Coast hip-hop.

bass_generator.brief: Produce deep bass lines using sample slices, focusing on matching drum rhythms and supporting hook-heavy energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chordal textures using sample layers forming a texture bed to support a minimal arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Design sparse melodic content through minimal sample variations to enhance mood without cluttering the mix.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement development ensuring energy curves and section transitions reinforce aggression and hook prominence.

presetor.brief: Apply presets to maintain minimal sonic space while supporting sample slicing techniques in channel naming and mixing.

songgps.brief: Coordinate arrangement structure and event markers to mark key sections and energy shifts aligned to hooks.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix tracks prioritizing clarity of one-shot hits and texture beds while preserving the minimal and aggressive vibe.
